card.name: Web address and email pieces
card.fires_on: Pieces of web addresses and emails just before a domain ending, such as itunes, facebook, ://, @example or www. Also fires on some partway-through codes like R406 or V600E.

modes.label: URL and email parts
modes.description: The site name, scheme or @example part right before .com, .org or a path.

modes.label: Inside drug or mutation codes
modes.description: A digit or letter partway through a compound code or unit.
